verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a SaaS and self-hostable data pipeline, so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no training-related policy. Self-hosting, encryption at rest and in transit, SOC 2, and the DPA are adjacent privacy controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
